q.g: In this quest you have to kill Glukhar and 6 of his guards. Next, you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the radar station area on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards, you have to extract via the "Cliff Descent" extraction. To use it, a Red Rebel ice pick and Paracord are required and you must not wear any Armor vest.
